chunks: Al-Faḍl ibn ʿAbd al-Malik narrated from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man catches one rakʿah, then he has caught the Jumuʿah prayer; and if it escapes him, then let him pray four.

key_terms.أَرْبَعًا: four rakʿahs, meaning the regular ẓuhr prayer in this context
key_terms.رَكْعَةً: one unit of prayer whose attainment determines whether Jumuʿah is counted
key_terms.فَاتَتْهُ: it passed him by or he missed it
key_terms.فَلْيُصَلِّ: then he should perform the prayer

ai.seo_question: If someone catches only one rakʿah of Jumuʿah, does it still count as Friday prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the Friday prayer. It states that whoever reaches one rakʿah of Jumuʿah has attained it, but if he misses it, he must perform four rakʿahs instead.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1234 - Al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) who said:
"If a person catches one rak'ah (of the Jumu’ah prayer), he has caught the Jumu’ah prayer. If he misses it, he should pray four (rak'ahs)."
